data.name: Dpc.Approx
data.value: Approximation without administrator rights: NEXUS reads the Windows counters "% DPC Time", "% Interrupt Time", "DPCs Queued/sec" and "Interrupts/sec" for each core once per second. Bad = some second with 20% or more of a core in drivers (or a 3% average); may cause hitches = 5% or more (or a 1% average). These limits are NEXUS's own, not a standard. The average duration of each call is time ÷ count: an average, not the worst case.
